summary: Phase 2 analytics features (#4 Insights funnel and #6 Tracker per-application timeline) verified end-to-end via Playwright. All scenarios in the review request passed: empty-state on /app/insights when localStorage is cleared, seeded funnel renders exact expected counts (planned=4, applied=3, interview=2, offer=1) and conversion dials (67% / 50% / 25%), the 4 stat cards read Total=4 / Active=3 / Interviews=1 / Offers=1, '1 rejected' is shown, Tracker lists 4 rows, the timeline-toggle expands a per-row timeline with ordered status pills and dates, and changing an application's status fires the '✓ Updated' toast AND appends the new status as the latest timeline entry. The previous-iteration hydration fix (allowedDevOrigins) continues to hold — client hydration is working, no Loading… deadlock observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning observed on every page render: 'Encountered a script tag while rendering React component. Scripts inside React components are never executed when rendering on the client.' This is non-blocking (likely from a <script> rendered inside a layout/PageHeader/Toaster); should be moved to next/script or removed.
lib/insights.ts: maxStageReached() also includes rejected (stageIndex returns -1, so rejected does not raise max — correct). However the comment says 'ignores rejected' which matches behaviour. Good.
Insights page conversion dial denominators correctly use reached counts (reached.applied=3, reached.interview=2, reached.offer=1) giving 2/3=67%, 1/2=50%, 1/4=25% — verified.
tracker/page.tsx Timeline uses key={i} on the <li> — fine for an append-only history but consider using event.at as key if entries become reorderable.
